title: Arab American Research
gallery_text: This map investigates the arrival of Arab Americans migrating to the U.S. in the late 1880s, and the last landmarked and protected piece of the immigrants' first colony.
description: The map is an inquiry into the spatiality of arrival and disappearance. It looks at what is "marked spatially" and at the inherent movement of the immigrant. It asks how this information can be transformed into a legible, information-based representation: one where movements are tracked, and where the marking of arrival becomes a tactile experience.
